text:
```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Free up disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: false
          dotnet: false
          haskell: false
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: false
          preinstalled-runtimes: false
          tool-cache: false
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install cargo-deb
        run: cargo install cargo-deb

      - name: Build Debian package
        run: cargo deb

      - name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA
        uses: hanselpr/ppa-publish@v1
        with:
          ppa-key: ${{ secrets.PPA_KEY }}
          ppa-repo: ${{ secrets.PPA_REPO }}
          ppa-username: ${{ secrets.PPA_USERNAME }}
          ppa-password: ${{ secrets.PPA_PASSWORD }}
          deb-file: target/debian/*.deb
```
